channel.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu
channel.description: National news and headlines from within or around India with live updates on major breaking events from The Hindu.

image.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu

item.title: Youth Congress workers protest outside Gadkari’s house in Nagpur, several detained
item.description: The police were deployed along with barricades on the route near Mr Gadkari’s house; several protesters attempted to climb over them to proceed. At least 30 Congress office bearers and party functionaries were detained

item.title: Noisy scenes in Punjab Assembly over paper leaks
item.description: During the Question Hour, Leader of the Opposition Partap Singh Bajwa raised the issue of alleged multiple examination paper leaks in Punjab over the last four-and-a-half years under the Aam Aadmi Party regime

item.title: Suvendu Adhikari to meet NCPI MPs in Delhi on August 4 as TMC stares at more exits
item.description: Speculations are rife that leaders from the ‘Kalighat camp’, which comprises of the loyalists of Trinamool founder Mamata Banerjee, are likely to switch sides and join the NCPI

item.title: ‘Donors got mixer grinders, cash’: blood banks in Bengal under scanner over ‘illegal’ sale to other States
item.description: Officials said around 11 blood banks have been barred from organising donation drives until the investigation is over. However, they are still permitted to collect blood from donors at their centres

item.title: Several WhatsApp users say their accounts 'put under review'
item.description: The disruption was highlighted around 8 p.m. IST when users started facing the issue without any prior warning from the Meta group's messaging app

item.title: Delhi police move against social media handles over misleading Jantar Mantar protest videos
item.description: Meta and X have been asked to remove videos falsely portraying the concluded agitation as ongoing, while police identify accounts for possible legal action

item.title: Cauvery water issue: DMK members walk out from both Houses in protest
item.description: DMK Rajya Sabha MP P. Wilson blames the Congress for ignoring the issue which he said affects nearly everyone in Tamil Nadu

item.title: Baghel asks workers to beware of ‘traitors’ within Punjab Congress
item.description: Addressing the gathering in Bathinda, he said the next elections will not be fought by the candidates alone, but by the entire party’s rank and file, underlining the need for strengthening the organisation at the grassroots level

item.title: Opposition MPs protest over Ram Temple donation theft
item.description: Members of the Samajwadi Party, who took part in the protest, say till now ₹47,000 has been collected and the money would be donated to the Ram Temple in Ayodhya and a receipt would be taken

item.title: Govt to sell up to 6.5% in LIC at ₹382/share; to add ₹31k crore to disinvestment kitty
item.description: If fully subscribed, the sale of over 82.22 crore shares or a 6.5% stake at the given floor price will fetch about ₹31,000 crore to the disinvestment kitty

item.title: The dilemma over PM SHRI in Kerala
item.description: The UDF is caught between the need for central funds and maintaining its integrity

item.title: 1.28 lakh people in seven Assam districts reel under floods; toll rises to 87 with two more deaths
item.description: The Assam State Disaster Management Authority (ASDMA), in its report, said both the deaths were reported from the worst-hit Sivasagar district

item.title: Amid a flood of holiday demands, Collectors weather an online storm
item.description: As online demands and criticism over rain holidays mount, District Collectors say decisions are guided by weather data and field reports—not social media pressure; school closures during orange, yellow alerts depend on local assessments, they say

item.title: Special rice sales counters opened in Vizag Rythu Bazars
Eight A.P. players selected for National U-19 Chess Championship
High-Power Committee proposed to address tribal issues in ASR district
World Anglo-Indian Day observed in Visakhapatnam
HTBF seeks Andhra University support for scholarship outreach
Rain eases, but swollen rivers keep flood-prone areas in Ernakulam district on alert
item.description: Following heavy downpours over the past few days, 110 people across the district took shelter in relief camps, with eight camps remaining active on Monday and four others closed

item.title: Prashant Kishor breaches BJP’s fortress in Bankipur
item.description: Former political strategist wins byelection in Bihar Assembly constituency left vacant by BJP chief Nitin Nabin; BJP retains Manjalpur in Gujarat, while Congress holds on to Datia in Madhya Pradesh

item.title: 21,522 candidates to appear for AP TET in Visakhapatnam
Treat water as infrastructure that must be built, paid for: CEA
Thirupparankundram lamp case: Nagenthran says SC not inclined to grant interim relief to T.N. govt.
Revised DPR not received by Cauvery Water Tribunal: MoS Choudhury tells Kamal Haasan
Disappointed at not getting Cabinet berth: Dinesh Gundu Rao
Mother’s death in road accident: Karnataka HC tells children to recover ₹25 lakh compensation from ‘offender’ father
A Cabinet expansion in Karnataka with twists, turns and heartbreak
item.description: The Cabinet expansion had its twists and turns as the initial list released in the morning underwent changes till the swearing-in at Lok Bhavan in the evening, causing confusion amid legislators not finding their names in the list

item.title: Congress’s decision to name legislators for Constitutional posts draws flak
item.description: The Congress’s decision to name its leaders for constitutional posts in the Legislative Assembly and the Legislative Council in its letterhead and make it public has come under flak

item.title: Kauvery Hospital, The Hindu to host webinar on vascular health
item.description: Titled ‘Vascular Health: Prevention, Healing and Limb Protection’, the webinar, part of Kauvery Hospital’s wellness series, will be held at 11.30 a.m on August 5

item.title: SC summons top Arunachal officials to explain ‘non-cooperation’ with CBI probe
item.description: The case involves allegations that Chief Minister Pema Khandu favoured firms linked to his family members in the award of government contracts over the past decade

item.title: Local held with anti-India posters, grenade in Kashmir’s Pulwama: officials
item.description: The posters described August 15 and August 5, the day the Centre ended J&K’s special status, as “black day”, while August 14, Pakistan’s Independence Day, as day of Independence

item.title: IAF Chief begins three-day visit to Vietnam to boost defence cooperation
item.description: The two sides explored new avenues to enhance collaboration, particularly in the air domain, as part of efforts to further strengthen the existing bilateral partnership

item.title: Thirupparankundram row: Supreme Court agrees to hear T.N. government plea, but gives the State no interim relief
item.description: The Bench queried whether there was a prevailing tradition of lighting the lamp on the pillar; the State said there were no historical records of lighting the lamp on the stone pillar.

item.title: Computer science, ECE still the most preferred subjects after first round of TNEA 2026 counselling
item.description: Electrical and electronics engineering, although way down the pecking order, did manage to register a gentle upward swing in the number of seats filled after the first round

item.title: Lok Satta leaders oppose proposal to set up RRB in Amaravati
Jipmer observes World Breastfeeding Week
item.description: The theme for WBW 2026 is “Breastfeeding for a Sustainable Start in Life: Strengthen What Works.”

item.title: Two MLAs nominated to Cusat Syndicate
Samyukt Kisan Morcha to meet all MPs, Ministers to campaign against trade pacts
item.description: The SKM maintains that such treaties are not in the interest of agricultural producers and farm workers in the country

item.title: Search continues for two missing in Kannur
Holiday declared in Kannur
Holiday declared in Malappuram
Kerala rains: heavy rain continues to batter district
item.description: A total of 964 people from 365 families remain in 32 relief camps in Kozhikode as heavy rain continues and schools remain shut for a second day; more than a dozen relief camps have closed in Wayanad after many displaced families returned home, leaving 584 people in 14 camps

item.title: Sriram Venkitaraman got exemptions that even P.T. Chacko did not get: Muraleedharan
item.description: The IAS officer is accused in the death of K.M. Basheer, the Thiruvananthapuram bureau chief of Malayalam daily Siraj , in 2019

item.title: SC asks Centre to ensure pedestrians have safe footpaths
item.description: A Bench headed by Justice P.S. Narasimha said the right to a clean and broad footpath was a fundamental right the state could afford to everyone without any big investment

item.title: 679th Foundation Day of Bahmani Empire observed in Kalaburagi
item.description: The 679th Foundation Day of the Bahmani Empire was observed at the tomb of Alauddin Hasan Bahman Shah, the founder and first ruler of the Sultanate, in Kalaburagi city on Monday

item.title: Stone pelting in Hubballi as protesters demanded ministerial berth to three-time MLA Prasad Abbayya
item.description: Hubballi witnessed a snap protest demaning ministerial berth to three-time MLA Prasad Abbayya on Monday. As the protest turned violent resulting in damages to a public transport bus, the police detained over 40 persons

item.title: Sheikh Hasina’s media event can hurt ties with India: Bangladesh
item.description: Dhaka expects India to ensure that no one used “Indian territory to make political statements or conduct any activities aimed at creating instability within Bangladesh”, a report from Bangladesh’s official news agency said

item.title: 3,444 students in Malappuram receive Plus One second supplementary allotment
item.description: In Malappuram where 5,532 applications were considered valid, including 812 from other districts, 1,607 vacancies remain for 2,088 students who did not get allotment

item.title: Study links prolonged heat exposure during pregnancy to adverse birth outcomes
item.description: First-trimester heat extremes were most critical for preterm birth, second trimester for low birth weight, and third trimester showed a higher risk for stillbirth, the study says

item.title: Cauvery water received by T.N. in July hits 50-year low
item.description: The realisation for the month did not even go past the one thousand million cubic feet-mark, with Biligundulu receiving only 0.698 tmcft against the State’s stipulated share of 31.24 tmcft

item.title: BJP, Opposition spar at panel meet over Meta’s content moderation practices
item.description: BJP MPs sought an apology from Meta chief Mark Zuckerberg over the temporary restriction of Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s Facebook post, while Opposition members cautioned against political influence over content moderation and argued that “technology should be regulated, not democracy”.

item.title: Continue commercial flight operations at Vizag airport: CPI to govt.
Badarli’s supporters stage protest
item.description: Followers of Sindhanur MLA Hampanagowda Badarli held a protest in Sindhanur and expressed anguish against Congress party’s high command for not including their leader in the State Cabinet. One of them even tried self-immolation, but the police foiled his attempt

item.title: Datia bypoll: Boost for Congress, Reality check for BJP
item.description: Congress candidate Ghanshyam Singh defeats BJP’s Ashutosh Tiwari by 6,016 votes

item.title: School van vandalised in Lucknow allegedly by Kanwariyas
item.description: In his complaint, Amir, the driver of the van, alleged that a group of youth riding motorcycles had thrown stones at the vecicle and also threatened to kill him before fleeing

item.title: Choice filling for second round of TNEA 2026 counselling begins
item.description: The window for choice filling for the second round will be open till 5 p.m. of August 5

item.title: Statues of the Buddha, N.T. Rama Rao unveiled at Parasam village
item.description: The Minister and Nellimarla MLA Lokam Naga Madhavi unveiled the statues in Vizianagaram district; Ms. Madhavi said two roads would be built at a cost of ₹20 lakh and local temples developed with the SriVani Trust’s support

item.title: Farmers’ groups protest over drinking water shortage in Kalaburagi, carry empty pots to highlight the issue
item.description: Members of the Samyukta Kisan Morcha and other farmers’ organisations, along with residents, staged a protest outside the Kalaburagi City Corporation office on Monday, carrying empty pots to highlight the acute drinking water shortage in the city

item.title: Prashant Kishor: From election backrooms to Bihar Assembly
item.description: Former election strategist Prashant Kishor is leading in Bankipur byelection

item.title: SIR not being done properly, alleges MLA Tenginakai
item.description: Alleging that SIR process is not being properly implemented in Hubballi city, Hubballi Dharwad Central MLA Mahesh Tenginakai says that he will file a complaint with Election Commission of India in this regard
